type.description: `agentgateway` (with the capture-extproc processor) or `litellm` (with the capture callback). Required.

publicUrl.description: The URL developers' tools use to reach the gateway. Empty: the cluster Service, reached with port-forward or `expose`.

digest.description: sha256 digest; pinned for every third-party image (Constitution VI, scripts/pin-digests.sh)

litellm.description: This project's LiteLLM image (LiteLLM plus the capture callback).

digest.description: sha256 digest; pinned for every third-party image (Constitution VI, scripts/pin-digests.sh)

gateway.description: The AI gateway developers' coding tools connect to (FR-001).

replicas.description: Replicas of capture-extproc. At least 2, so one can restart while the other serves (R2). docs/sizing.md: about one per 500 developers.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding the provider API keys: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, or the names given in `apiKeyName`.

name.description: The model name tools request (for example `claude-sonnet-5-5`).

provider.description: The API the gateway speaks to the provider.

model.description: The provider's model ID (for OpenRouter, for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`).

baseUrl.description: An API-compatible service instead of the provider itself, for example `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.

apiKeyName.description: The key in `providers.existingSecret` holding this route's API key (default: the provider's).

models.description: Model routes. A tool asks for a route by `name`; the gateway calls `model` at `provider`.

providers.description: Bring-your-own provider keys (FR-039). Empty in demo mode.

github.description: The GitHub App, from `gca setup github-app` (FR-035). Secrets are referenced, never put in values.

org.description: The organization whose owners, teams and maintainers drive roles and team totals (FR-027, FR-029a).

host.description: GitHub.com (including Enterprise Cloud); the only host in v1.

delivery.description: `polling` (every 30 s; nothing public needed) or `webhook` (needs `publicUrl`). See docs/github-app.md.

publicUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL GitHub delivers webhooks to (`{publicUrl}/webhooks/github`). Required for `webhook`.

pendingCapMinutes.description: How long a head waits for capture to catch up before it's attributed anyway, with coverage marked (R12).

headlineIncludesBroad.description: Count broad (lower-confidence) matches in the check run's headline percentages. Always shown in the summary.

annotations.description: Annotations for the Ingress (for example cert-manager's).

tlsSecret.description: TLS Secret for the Ingress host.

prcheck.description: The PR check service (FR-023 to FR-025).

matchingWindowDays.description: How far back from a PR head captured AI output can match its lines.

retentionDays.description: Days captured fingerprints are kept (daily partitions are dropped after this). Storage grows with it: docs/sizing.md.

exclusions.description: Glob patterns of files never attributed (listed as excluded in the check).

attribution.description: Matching settings. Applied at install and upgrade; admins can change them in the portal (US3).

visibleRoles.description: Roles that see other developers' results: `admin`, and `team_lead` for their own teams.

existingSecret.description: A Secret to use. Empty: generated at install and kept across upgrades; rotate in the portal.

internal.description: Run the official postgres:17 image as a StatefulSet. `false`: use `external`.

storage.description: Volume size for the internal database. 200Gi holds 90 days for 500 developers (docs/sizing.md).

existingSecret.description: Secret with `username`, `password` and `reportingPassword` (Grafana's read-only role). Required when `internal` is false.

external.description: An existing PostgreSQL 17 (needs the btree_gin extension, which ships with PostgreSQL).

storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the volume (empty: the cluster default).

digest.description: sha256 digest; pinned for every third-party image (Constitution VI, scripts/pin-digests.sh)

adminLogins.description: GitHub logins with the admin role besides the organization's owners (needed on a personal account).

publicUrl.description: The browser-reachable portal URL (GitHub sign-in returns here).

portal.description: The portal: sign-in, gateway credentials, per-developer views, admin settings.

demo.description: Demo mode (FR-038): a deterministic model, so the stack runs with no provider key.

enabled.description: Deploy demo-model and route the demo model names (`demo-anthropic`, `demo-openai`, `demo-gemini`) to it.
Allow `gca demo run` against this install.

images.description: This project's images (built by scripts/build-images.sh, released by release.yml).

registry.description: Registry and owner of the `gca-*` images.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the `gca-*` images.

digests.description: Digest per image name (`capture-extproc`, `ingest`, `prcheck`, `portal`, `demo`). A release sets them from the images it builds, so the chart pins them (T119).

enabled.description: Only the services that use them reach PostgreSQL, NATS, the capture processor and the demo model. Needs a network plugin that enforces NetworkPolicy.

expose.description: For local clusters: NodePorts that kind maps to localhost (scripts/demo.sh).

nodePorts.description: Expose the portal and gateway on NodePorts.

nats.description: The official NATS chart (JetStream, single node), passed through: see its documentation. Set here: JetStream on a 10Gi volume, Pod Security "restricted" security contexts, no nats-box.

enabled.description: Deploy NATS. Capture and ingest need it unless you point them at your own.

grafana.description: The grafana-community chart, passed through: see its documentation. Set here: GitHub sign-in, the read-only Postgres datasource, the dashboards, and `publicUrl`.

enabled.description: Deploy Grafana with the aggregate dashboards (R15).

publicUrl.description: The browser-reachable Grafana URL (GitHub sign-in returns here).
